scope: All 34 open issues at review start; classify current promises and retained growth. This is not a new whole-code, GPU or final-artifact certification.

decisions.title_at_review: Publish the synchronized guide for Ackredit's accepted portable contract
decisions.action_or_evidence: Portable guide already published at d0d5ea85; later canonical-guide refresh/adoption remains separate.

decisions.title_at_review: Update the Mol* dependency after 1.0
decisions.action_or_evidence: Mol* dependency update, imported-API review and exact core qualification; retain the current pin for 1.0.

decisions.title_at_review: Evaluate aligned PySide6/Qt for a future supported standalone host
decisions.action_or_evidence: Future supported Qt candidate: exact native artifacts and visible-window workflows; no core gate.

decisions.title_at_review: Migrate optional Qt host to canonical PySide6 6.11.2
decisions.action_or_evidence: Canonical binding selection is implemented; current Qt/WebGL evidence still fails on some environments. Do not certify it from import/solver success.

decisions.title_at_review: Define reproducible browser and render-worker E2E evidence lanes
decisions.action_or_evidence: Core/portable/render-worker lanes exist and core is qualified. Portable remote and managed GPU completion retain independent candidate requirements; exclusion is not a pass.

decisions.title_at_review: Clarify the Linux-only support boundary of the Qt standalone host
decisions.action_or_evidence: Public core, experimental native hosts and remote preview are distinguished consistently; addressable docs guard.

decisions.title_at_review: README offers a pip installation route that cannot succeed
decisions.action_or_evidence: Remove unsupported public pip install/update commands; correct backend/addon and Windows claims.

decisions.title_at_review: Coordinate MolSysViewer Python 3.14 support with MolSysMT
decisions.action_or_evidence: Public pair 16/16 and source 3.14 gates are delivered. Remote suite registry still says authorized; obtain central admission. Qt has separate owners.

decisions.title_at_review: 0.20.1, 0.22.0 and 0.23.0 never reached npm: the runtime build required a file the publisher never has
decisions.action_or_evidence: Do not recover historical npm 0.20.1/0.22.0/0.23.0; preserve missing-runtime caveat and future publication verification.

decisions.title_at_review: Publish the 0.22.0 and 0.23.0 GitHub Releases once Phase 10 closes the dependency channels
decisions.action_or_evidence: Do not backfill Releases/Zenodo for 0.22.0/0.23.0; retain tags. Verified 0.24.0 supersedes that release work.

decisions.title_at_review: Report upstream to pytest-xdist: an import in the receiver thread can end the session
decisions.action_or_evidence: External pytest-xdist report remains prepared, not sent. Requires explicit authorization for the third-party submission; not a reproduced current core defect.

decisions.title_at_review: 219 quarantined digesters are in limbo: decide whether they are deleted
decisions.action_or_evidence: Retain 219 quarantined modules outside installed/runtime package for 1.0; no deletion or restoration.

decisions.title_at_review: Advanced representations for pockets, voids, channels and interfaces
decisions.action_or_evidence: Advanced pocket/void/channel/interface representations beyond shipped primitives and shape providers.

decisions.title_at_review: View a scene as pixels in a terminal
decisions.action_or_evidence: Add a terminal pixel presentation; existing pixel/export tools are not a shipped terminal viewer.

decisions.title_at_review: Generated typing contract for MolSysView mixins
decisions.action_or_evidence: Generated static typing for assembled mixins; do not infer that runtime validation supplies type stubs.

decisions.title_at_review: Studio subpanel for Interactions
decisions.action_or_evidence: Minimal Studio Interactions is shipped and qualified. Remaining richer source modes, analytics and dynamic workflows only.

decisions.title_at_review: Structure windowing and lazy materialization
decisions.action_or_evidence: Lazy/windowed trajectory residence changes view.molsys semantics; 1.0 retains complete selected-structure materialization and its size guard.

decisions.title_at_review: Post-1.0 performance architecture
decisions.action_or_evidence: Further topology encoding/residency/Qt join performance; existing measured ceilings are not arbitrary-scale certification.

decisions.title_at_review: Move the structure barrier to the receiver
decisions.action_or_evidence: Receiver-owned structure barrier for endpoints beyond the current sender contract.

decisions.title_at_review: Automate the Qt render check on a GPU runner
decisions.action_or_evidence: Automated native Qt framebuffer/workflow check on a qualified GPU runner; prior manual evidence is not broad host support.

decisions.title_at_review: Popout parity in the Qt standalone host
decisions.action_or_evidence: Qt popout parity; live Jupyter popouts do not certify the separate Qt shell.

decisions.title_at_review: Idea inventory from an external terminal viewer
decisions.action_or_evidence: External terminal-viewer ideas remain an inventory, not accepted 1.0 functionality.

decisions.title_at_review: Multi-view split-screen viewport synchronization
decisions.action_or_evidence: Multiple synchronized viewports; progressive multi-source loading is already delivered and is a different capability.

decisions.title_at_review: An Interactions domain for derived atom-atom relations
decisions.action_or_evidence: Native analyses, nine families, queries, geometry, H5MSM/session and minimal Studio are delivered. Additional formats, persistence/residence analytics and dynamic evaluation remain.

decisions.title_at_review: Rough edges of the 2026-08 export rework, to review cold
decisions.action_or_evidence: Export-rework design tradeoffs to revisit on evidence; not a blanket assertion that current export paths fail.

decisions.title_at_review: Preserve enriched chemical metadata from SDF and MOL2
decisions.action_or_evidence: SDF/protein composition and hierarchy fixes #312/#313 are delivered. Preserve the distinct enhanced chemical metadata/schema review; successful load alone does not prove every enrichment.

decisions.title_at_review: Configurable canvas picking granularity via the context menu
decisions.action_or_evidence: User-configurable atom/group/chain picking granularity; current supported selection actions remain qualified.

decisions.title_at_review: Advanced annotations on Mol*'s MVS machinery
decisions.action_or_evidence: Richer MVS annotation behavior beyond the current supported anchors/lifecycle.

decisions.title_at_review: Study the token cost of non-pytest test output for agent consumers
decisions.action_or_evidence: Measure non-pytest output token costs; no scientific/runtime capability depends on completing that study.

decisions.title_at_review: Adopt MolSysMT's explicit source-form hint once it exists
decisions.disposition: Provider API improvement; outside core gate
decisions.action_or_evidence: Published 0.23.0 repairs extension detection; measured 95k-atom detection 2.319 s. Explicit source hint still absent, provider #151 open; benchmark-only direct import remains.

decisions.title_at_review: Offer MolSysMT a read of their documentation pipeline at the scale it is reaching
decisions.action_or_evidence: Historical documentation-pipeline analysis offered to MolSysMT; a provider migration is not a promised Viewer feature.

decisions.title_at_review: Build the runtime as a classic script so exported views open from a disk
decisions.action_or_evidence: Classic-script shared runtime for opening a many-view bundle directly from disk; current served/shared and self-contained HTML remain separate supported routes.

decisions.title_at_review: Standalone Qt movie export lacks a camera snapshot
decisions.action_or_evidence: Qt orbit export lacks a returned camera snapshot; retain the defect instead of treating core camera/movie tests as Qt closure.

decisions.title_at_review: Standalone Qt: live demo replacement does not update the scene
decisions.action_or_evidence: Live replacement fix and automated guards exist; ten visible-window replacements and Ready/no-delivery-error confirmation remain unperformed.

form_detection_probe.convert_signature: (molecular_system, to_form='molsysmt.MolSys', selection='all', structure_indices='all', syntax='MolSysMT', strict=False, return_report=False, skip_digestion=False, **kwargs)
form_detection_probe.scope: form detection only; no conversion/parser/render timing

form_detection_reproduction:
import importlib.util,json,time,tracemalloc,inspect
import molsysmt as msm
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('endpoint_fixture','/home/diego/repos@uibcdf/molsysviewer/devtools/benchmarks/endpoint_isolation.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
result={'molsysmt_version':msm.__version__,'provider_path':msm.__file__,'convert_signature':str(inspect.signature(msm.convert)),'scope':'form detection only; no conversion/parser/render timing'}
# Warm imports on a small input, then measure only detection of the existing large benchmark fixture.
msm.get_form(module.make_pdb(10))
payload=module.make_pdb(95000)
tracemalloc.start(); start=time.perf_counter(); form=msm.get_form(payload)
result.update(n_atoms=95000,payload_bytes=len(payload),form=form,seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,peak_traced_bytes=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1])
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
